input.quote: Commerce One warrants that the Software and MarketSite.net Service will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation, and the media on which the Software is distributed will be free from defects in materials and workmanship under normal use, for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period").
input.rationale: Section 7.3 gives a conformance-to-Documentation warranty but only for sixty (60) days measured from the Effective Date and capped at December 31, 1999. That is below both the preferred 12-month software period and the 90-day fallback, and because Acceptance Testing under Section 3.1 can run through December 31, 1999, the Warranty Period could lapse before or at acceptance, leaving us with effectively no conformance warranty. The remedy in 7.3/7.4 (correction, replacement, and refund of prepaid fees on termination) and the no-malicious-code warranty are acceptable, but there is no warranty that Commerce One's installation, implementation, training or other professional services (Sections 5.1, 5.2, 5.5, 5.6) will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. Redline extends the period to 12 months from acceptance and adds a services warranty with re-performance/refund.

proposal.summary: Extend product warranty to 12 months from acceptance and add a services warranty with re-performance/refund remedy
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the product warranty to twelve (12) months running from our acceptance of the Software, since a 60-day period measured from the Effective Date with a December 31, 1999 outside date would expire at or before the close of Acceptance Testing under Section 3.1 and leave us with no conformance warranty. We have also added a professional and workmanlike warranty for Commerce One's installation, implementation, training and other professional services, with re-performance or refund as the remedy; if helpful, we can accept ninety (90) days for the Software and thirty (30) days for services as a fallback.

ops.text: 7.5 Services Warranty. Commerce One warrants that all installation, implementation, support, training and other professional services provided under this Agreement will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards by personnel with the requisite skill and experience. If Commerce One breaches this warranty, Commerce One shall, at Corio's request, re-perform the non-conforming services at no additional charge or, if re-performance is not commercially practicable, refund the fees paid for such non-conforming services.
